## Summary

Describe the problem and the change.

## Type of change

- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] New feature
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] CI or checks
- [ ] Refactor

## Checklist

- [ ] `make check` passes locally.
- [ ] New behaviour is covered by a test.
- [ ] Documentation is updated when behaviour changes.
- [ ] No webhook URL, key, org ID, state file, or `config.env` is included.
- [ ] Commits are signed and carry `Co-authored-by` and `Signed-off-by`.
